interface.longDescription: Coconet connects Codex to a local fail-open runtime for automatic Session synchronization, Work DAG and Library metadata discovery, exact-node conversation Pull for local reading and search, and independent Session Fork with native history for the same Agent or main dialogue conversion across Codex and Claude.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the connected Coconet Project's Work DAG for relevant work, then Pull a selected node's conversation when needed.
